title: Various Super Mario World Enemies In Winter Style
description:
Various Smw Enemies In Winter Style.

Ripped from this sheet.

Goombud is to be used with this sprite.

Ceiling spiny and to be used with this sprite.

Use Tweaker to change the Goomba, Para-Goomba, Lakitu to palette row D.
Change the Ground Dweling Monty Mole palette row to F.(You need to use Hex Editor to change the Ledge Dweling Monty Mole palette row)

Credit is required.
